notes: Qty 59 as published: the Interrupts header says 11 but 10 are listed (Sense x3, Alter x2, Twi'lek, Monnok, Control, We Have A Prisoner x2); the other section counts match. The '>' quote marks and section headers are not cards.

Posted 'KKK' dested Kitik Keed'kak (the only Dark card with those initials in the 1999 pool). 'Brangus' Brangus Glee; 'Cabbel' Lieutenant Cabbel; 'Evax' Officer Evax; 'Ozzel' Admiral Ozzel; 'Tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin.
'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'EPP Fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Drazin' Corporal Drazin; 'BUS' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser.
'Carbonite Chamber' (under Locations) dested Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; 'CC Docking Bay' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Audience Chamber' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber.

'A Bright Center' dested A Bright Center To The Universe; 'Bad Feeling' Bad Feeling Have I; 'CCO' Cloud City Occupation (the strategy's 'occupation'); 'IAO' Imperial Arrest Order; 'SEC Precautions' Security Precautions; 'TBHTP' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Twi'lek' Twi'lek Advisor.
Resistance, Battle Order and Oppressive Enforcement are the older Effects (not the later Defensive Shields).
